name: MoviOdds bet365 Odds API
description:
MoviOdds serves exclusively bet365 odds for soccer, tennis, basketball, American football, ice hockey, baseball, rugby union and league, cricket and Australian rules (more sports being added): every market bet365 prices for a match, pre-match and in-play. Soccer is the default; pass sport=<key> (see the sport parameter), or sport=all, to /odds and /catalog for other sports. Load the board with GET /odds, then keep it current over the WebSocket at wss://moviodds.com/ws (send {"op":"subscribe"}, optionally with "fixtures" and "groups" lists; you receive a snapshot per match, then delta messages as prices change, and a remove message when a market closes or a match leaves the board). WebSockets are not describable in OpenAPI, so the stream is documented at https://moviodds.com/doc.

The odds feed needs no key. Only POST /betbuilder/price needs an API key (X-API-Key).

MoviOdds is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by bet365.
